answer: Locks are recorded in whisper, expire in ridge, and opal lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 189 aliases therefore needs 33 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4273 identities would post 902 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
